entities.name: Capture of Erivan
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The capture of Erivan took place on 1 October 1827, during the Russo-Persian War of 1826–28. The city fell to the Russians after being besieged for a week and opened up the path for the eventual capture of Tabriz, the second largest city in Iran and an important trading post.
